Shipping & returns

Shipping

  • Free tracked shipping on orders over $75; $6 flat below that.
  • Orders placed before 2pm ship the same business day.
  • Delivery in 2–5 business days domestically, 7–14 internationally. Duties for international orders are paid by the recipient.

Returns & exchanges

  • 30 days from delivery, unworn and unwashed, with tags.
  • Size exchanges are free — reply to your order email with the size you need and we'll send a prepaid label.
  • Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 business days of us receiving the return.

Something wrong with your order?

Reply to your confirmation email with a photo and your order number and we'll fix it — replacement or refund, your call.
